title: Little Red Dots Could Be Ancient Globular Clusters, Each Dominated by a Super-Massive Star
description: Little Red Dots are one of the mysteries uncovered by the JWST. Astronomers have been trying to figure out what they are, and have come up with multiple possibilities. New research says they could be ancient Globular Clusters with supermassive stars in their centers.

title: Ancient footprints offer rare glimpse into lives of extinct human relatives
description: A remarkable set of footprints preserved along the shores of Kenya’s Lake Turkana from more than one million years ago is giving scientists an unusually detailed look at how one of humanity’s extinct relatives may have lived, moved and socialized.
